entity.name: United States Grand Prix (Circuit of The Americas)
entity.summary: Circuit of The Americas (COTA) in Austin hosts the Formula 1 United States Grand Prix each October and is completing its move to a year-round entertainment campus. It earns from race and MotoGP tickets and hospitality, sponsorship, the new COTALAND theme park, concerts and The Circuit private members club.

summary.headline: COTA just drew a record 467,000 race fans, opens its new theme park's first holiday season on Nov 20 and now bills next year's race as the Formula 1 Pirelli United States Grand Prix, so most of its fan touchpoints are about to be redesigned.
bullets: Race week drew a record 467,000 fans across four days, helped by a new $20 Thursday ticket and a 'Biggest Weekend Ever' campaign on airport decals, billboards and online ads.
COTALAND opened in late September with 30+ rides and a target of 1.5 million visitors a year, and Peppermint in the Park runs Nov 20 to Jan 3.
From Jan 2 the main track becomes The Circuit, a members-only club, while MotoGP returns Apr 23-25 and the 2027 race is set for Oct 22-24.

signals.title: Record 467,000 fans at the 2026 race
signals.summary: The 2026 United States Grand Prix drew a record 467,000 fans to COTA, as reported by ESPN and cited by BizBash. Race chief Bobby Epstein had said in July that sales were on pace for a record year.

signals.title: $20 Grand PrixView Thursday made race week four days
signals.summary: COTA added Grand PrixView Thursday on Oct 22. For $20 fans got the F1 Academy paddock, the Fan Villages and COTALAND, and 7,000 local students aged 11-12 attended free.

signals.title: 'Biggest Weekend Ever' campaign on airport decals, billboards and online ads
signals.summary: COTA's race-week campaign ran airport floor decals, billboards and online ads that linked back to COTA's website.

signals.title: Big brands ran their own race-week activations around Austin
signals.summary: Red Bull Race Nights, a free four-day fan zone in East Austin, welcomed over 12,000 guests with partners including AT&T. Delta and American Express drew more than 1,200 guests to a pop-up at Domain NORTHSIDE, and Google Gemini and McLaren ran a pop-up in a vintage gas station.

signals.title: COTALAND opened with 30+ rides and a 1.5 million visitor goal
signals.summary: COTALAND, a 30-acre theme park with more than 30 rides and attractions, held its grand opening Sept 26-27, 2026 with $99 Saturday and $65 Sunday tickets. Single-day tickets now run $39.99 to $75, and the park expects about 1,300 staff and eventually 1.5 million visitors a year.

signals.title: Headline coaster stopped twice on opening weekend
signals.summary: The Circuit Breaker coaster stopped twice with riders on board during COTALAND's opening weekend. COTALAND said riders exited with no injuries.

signals.title: Peppermint in the Park runs Nov 20 to Jan 3
signals.summary: COTALAND's holiday event combines lights, rides, a Christmas market and Santa from Nov 20, 2026 through Jan 3, 2027. All-Day Holiday Passes start at $39.99.

signals.title: Main track becomes The Circuit, a members-only club, in January
signals.summary: From 2027 the Grand Prix track is limited to members, select races and special events. The Circuit offers year-round track access and curated driving experiences from a clubhouse above Turn 1, with never more than 300 members, and COTA's site asks prospects to register their interest.

signals.title: COTA plans a second, shorter track and a year-round campus
signals.summary: COTA is completing its transition into a year-round entertainment venue and has advanced plans for a second, shorter circuit for cars and motorcycles.

signals.title: Race contracted through 2034
signals.summary: Formula 1 extended the United States Grand Prix at COTA through the 2034 season. The race has drawn over 430,000 fans in recent years and delivered US$7 billion in economic impact to Austin and Texas.

signals.title: 2027 race is billed as the Formula 1 Pirelli United States Grand Prix
signals.summary: COTA's ticket page already sells the 2027 race, Oct 22-24, 2027, under the name Formula 1 Pirelli United States Grand Prix, replacing the MSC Cruises name used in 2025 and 2026.

signals.title: MSC Cruises title-sponsored 2026 and picks three races for 2027
signals.summary: MSC Cruises was title sponsor of the 2026 race for the second consecutive year and is scheduled to sponsor three races in 2027. Its ship MSC Seascape has sailed year-round from Galveston since Nov 9, 2025.

signals.title: T-Mobile brings 5G fan activations and Club Magenta to COTA
signals.summary: Starting in 2026, T-Mobile brings 5G-connected technologies for broadcast and fan activations to the race, has upgraded its network at COTA and debuted its Club Magenta lounge in Austin.

signals.title: MotoGP returns Apr 23-25, 2027 with tickets on sale
signals.summary: The MotoGP Red Bull Grand Prix of the Americas comes to COTA on April 23-25, 2027, and tickets are already on sale.

signals.title: COTA app holds mobile tickets, with Ticketmaster for single days
signals.summary: Fans open mobile tickets in the COTA App and show a barcode at the gate. Single-day race and concert buyers use Ticketmaster.

signals.title: Zoox active at the Austin race
signals.summary: Zoox, a Williams F1 team partner, is involved with events at the Austin and Miami races, and became the Las Vegas race's ride-hail partner in Nov 2026.

signals.title: F1 runs its own fan-zone QR prize draws
signals.summary: Formula 1's F1 Unlocked program ran QR-code prize draws in fan zones in 2025. Entrants need an F1 Unlocked or F1.com account, so the data lands with Formula 1.

opportunities.title: Build codes into the 2027 Pirelli race artwork before it goes to print
opportunities.whatsHappening: COTA already sells the Oct 22-24, 2027 race as the Formula 1 Pirelli United States Grand Prix, after two years under the MSC Cruises name. A name change means new artwork for tickets, wayfinding, grandstand signage and merch for a race that drew a record 467,000 fans.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: A rebrand is the cheapest moment to add codes, because every asset is being redesigned anyway. Branded Flowcodes in the new artwork can change destination after printing, so one asset serves presale, race week and post-race offers, and a Workspace gives the new title partner its own scan reporting. C3 Presents drove 1.3M+ scans across multi-stage festival sites with this pattern.
play: Add branded Flowcodes to the 2027 design system: ticket backs, wayfinding, grandstand boards and merch tags.
Route by date: presale and hospitality now, schedule and food during race week, 2028 deposits after the flag.
Set up a Workspace with separate spaces for COTA and the title partner, each with live dashboards.
Report scans by asset type so the 2028 print budget follows the assets that worked.
kpis: Presale and hospitality revenue from scans

timing.window: While 2027 race artwork is being designed, ahead of production

opportunities.buyer: COTA marketing and creative lead for the United States Grand Prix

timeliness.why: the new name is already live on ticketing

fit.why: dynamic codes in printed assets is the core product

access.why: title assets may need F1 and partner sign-off

caveats: Pirelli as title partner is inferred from the 2027 event name on COTA's ticket page. No deal announcement was found.
COTA's 2027 print and production schedule is not public.

opportunities.title: Turn COTALAND's first holiday season into the start of a year-round guest record
opportunities.whatsHappening: COTALAND opened in late September with more than 30 rides and expects to eventually see 1.5 million visitors a year. Its first holiday event, Peppermint in the Park, runs Nov 20 to Jan 3 with lights, rides, a Christmas market and Santa.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: Theme park guests are mostly local families, the same people COTA wants at its $20 race-week Thursday and at MotoGP. Codes at the Christmas market, Santa line and ride exits feed a FlowHub, FlowID turns each scan into a known guest, and CRM sync lets COTA offer season passes, MotoGP tickets and race-week days to the same family. The Penguins saw 88% conversion from in-venue prompts.
play: Place Flowcodes at the Santa line, the Christmas market stalls and ride exits for Peppermint in the Park.
Route to a holiday photo or prize entry with opt-in, then to season passes and MotoGP family tickets.
Capture FlowID and sync guests to COTA's CRM, tagged by visit date and spend.
Report holiday-to-MotoGP and holiday-to-race conversion in the spring.
kpis: Guest opt-ins during Peppermint in the Park
Season pass and MotoGP sales from scans
Share of 2027 race buyers who first visited COTALAND

timing.window: Peppermint in the Park, Nov 20 to Jan 3, then the 2027 park season

opportunities.buyer: COTALAND general manager and COTA marketing

timeliness.why: holiday event opens in three days

scale.why: target of 1.5 million visitors a year

access.why: COTA owns the park and the race

caveats: Three days is short lead time. If the holiday launch is missed, pitch the 2027 park season.
Actual COTALAND attendance has not been published. 1.5 million is the park's long-term expectation.
Opening-weekend ride stoppages may make the park cautious about new guest-facing tools.

opportunities.title: Give each airport decal and billboard its own code for the MotoGP and 2027 race campaigns
opportunities.whatsHappening: COTA's 'Biggest Weekend Ever' campaign ran airport floor decals, billboards and online ads that linked back to its website, and the race drew a record 467,000 fans. MotoGP returns Apr 23-25, 2027 with tickets already on sale, so its campaign is next.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: A billboard that points to a website cannot say which placement sold tickets. A Flowcode or FlowURL per placement attributes each scan to the decal, board or ad behind it, and the same codes can switch from MotoGP to the October race without reprinting. CLEAR's 1.2M+ connections across 7,000+ airport touchpoints show the airport format works.
play: Assign one code per placement: each airport decal set, each billboard face, each digital ad.
Route to MotoGP tickets through April, then switch the same codes to 2027 race tickets.
Capture FlowID on scan and sync scan-to-purchase data to the ticketing CRM.
Shift the race campaign's media budget toward the placements that sold MotoGP tickets.
kpis: Cost per ticket sold by channel

timing.window: MotoGP campaign in Q1 2027, then the October race campaign

scale.why: the media that filled a record race week

fit.why: OOH attribution is Flowcode's core pitch

caveats: Whether COTA already tracks placements with unique URLs is not public. Ask first.
Airport placements may need approval from the airport's media concessionaire.

opportunities.title: Measure the four-day race week village by village, starting with the $20 Thursday
opportunities.whatsHappening: COTA added a $20 Grand PrixView Thursday with the F1 Academy paddock, the Fan Villages and COTALAND, and hosted 7,000 local students. Race week drew a record 467,000 fans, and fans enter with barcodes in the COTA App or tickets from Ticketmaster.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: The ticket scan at the gate shows who came in, not where they went or what they wanted next. A code per village and day shows where fans spend time, and FlowID turns a Thursday or Ticketmaster buyer into a known fan COTA can sell COTALAND, MotoGP and next year's race to. Sports clients see 75% higher than average conversion for first-party data with Flowcode.
play: One code per Fan Village, day and screen, routed to that day's schedule, food and merch.
Give Thursday visitors and student families a COTALAND or MotoGP offer behind an opt-in.
Sync opt-ins to COTA's CRM, matched to COTA App and Ticketmaster buyers.
Use location and time data to plan the 2027 village layout.
kpis: Thursday visitors converted to other COTA events
Merch and food revenue from scans

timing.window: 2027 race week, Oct 22-24, planned through spring

opportunities.buyer: Fan experience lead, Circuit of The Americas
caveats: F1 controls the F1 Fan Zone and runs its own QR prize draws through F1 Unlocked. Position Flowcode as COTA's own identity layer.
Single-day buyers come through Ticketmaster, which may limit the data COTA already holds on them.

opportunities.title: Fill The Circuit's 300 seats with prospects identified at COTA's own events
opportunities.whatsHappening: From January the Grand Prix track becomes The Circuit, a members-only club with year-round track access and never more than 300 members. COTA's site asks prospects to register their interest, and COTA is planning a second, shorter track partly for the people it is displacing.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: Club sales need named, qualified prospects, and COTA already hosts them in hospitality suites at MotoGP and the race. A discreet code in premium suites and the clubhouse tour routes to a private interest page, FlowID records who scanned and where, and CRM sync puts each lead in front of the membership team the same day.
play: Place codes in race and MotoGP hospitality suites, the Turn 1 clubhouse tour and track-day check-in.
Route premium guests to The Circuit interest page and displaced track-day drivers to the second-track waitlist.
Capture FlowID with event, seat and session data, synced to the membership CRM.
Report lead-to-member conversion by event.

timing.window: Club opens Jan 2, MotoGP hospitality in April

scale.why: 300 members at most, though each is high value

fit.why: useful lead capture, but a small, high-touch sale

caveats: Membership pricing was not found in official sources.
Much of the club may already be sold through private networks before January.

opportunities.title: Sell race-week brands a measurement kit, then sell to them directly
opportunities.whatsHappening: Red Bull Race Nights welcomed over 12,000 guests, Delta and American Express drew more than 1,200 to a pop-up, and Google Gemini with McLaren ran its own pop-up. T-Mobile brings 5G fan activations and Club Magenta to COTA, and MSC Cruises is choosing three races to sponsor in 2027.
opportunities.whyFlowcode: Brands spend heavily on Austin race week, and the public recap shows no way they measured who came. COTA can bundle Flowcode measurement into official partner packages, and each brand is a Flowcode prospect in its own right. NFL Shop's $250 revenue per scan is the kind of number these brands want to report.
play: Package a measured-activation add-on for 2027 partner proposals, starting with T-Mobile and the new title partner.
Give each brand its own codes and dashboard in a shared Workspace.
Route scans to brand offers after a COTA opt-in, so both sides get data.
Pass brand contacts to Flowcode sales as follow-on prospects.
opportunities.buyer: COTA partnerships team, and brand experiential leads directly
caveats: Red Bull, Delta and Google activations were off-site, outside COTA's control.
A recap that does not mention data capture does not prove there was none.
